{
 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==background or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in comp); r1=max(y for y,x in comp)
            c0=min(x for y,x in comp); c1=max(x for y,x in comp)
            if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
            points=set(comp)
            if not all((r0,x) in points and (r1,x) in points for x in range(c0,c1+1)): continue
            if not all((y,c0) in points and (y,c1) in points for y in range(r0,r1+1)): continue
